calls.title: Dave Johnson and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The discussion centered on strategies to enhance podcast production and content repurposing for lead generation. Key points included utilizing separate feed recordings for better clip creation, aiming to produce around 20 episodes monthly, and focusing on shorter 60 to 90-second clips to maximize engagement. Guests were urged to share personal stories to boost shareability, while active interviewing techniques were emphasized to improve clarity and flow during episodes. Additionally, the team identified the need for user-friendly editing tools like Riverside and Descript while ensuring human oversight for quality. Coordinated multi-channel publishing and leveraging educational content for leads were also highlighted as crucial for building authentic relationships and nurturing engagement.
calls.keywords: podcast strategy, content repurposing, guest prep, lead generation, video editing tools, LinkedIn advertising
